note: 24 Oct 2026 - 'Holiday Rewind, Our Favorite Show From This Year! | Ep. 77' (Rumble v62tz85). Weekly agent. This episode is mostly politics (Trump/RFK), religion (the Ten Commandments debate) and a direct fundraising pitch for the FTC settlement - all skipped per PLANNING.md. Four clean, self-contained story/teaching segments survive: the bail-money loan, its 20-years-later payback, the Dale Carnegie party story, and the insurance/fishing sales story. 4 clips, not 6-9, because that's all the usable minutes this episode holds - fewer good clips beat more weak ones.

clips.caption:
A friend's wife called in a panic - her husband was in a Florida jail, and the only way out was $250,000 in cash.

Kevin Trudeau didn't negotiate a payment plan. He got on his private jet and brought the cash himself that night.

He told his friend: pay me back whenever you can - or don't.

Years went by. The friend never brought the money up again, too embarrassed to face it. Kevin never asked either.

He wasn't counting on seeing a dollar of it again. He just knew he'd planted a seed.

#kevintrudeau #wealthmindset #generosity #lawofattraction #manifestation #successmindset

Twenty years after quietly covering a friend's $250,000 bail, Kevin Trudeau got a phone call he didn't expect.

The friend said he still couldn't believe Kevin had never once asked for the money back.

He said a couple of good real estate deals had finally put him in a position to pay it off.

He didn't write a check for $250,000. He wrote one for $1 million, and said, "I always remember my friends."

What you give without strings has a way of coming back multiplied.

#kevintrudeau #wealthmindset #givingback #manifestation #moneymindset #success

Dale Carnegie was invited to the biggest party of the New York social season for one reason - he was known as the world's greatest conversationalist.

Kevin Trudeau tells the story of what happened when the hostess cornered him to hear his travel stories.

Carnegie never mentioned a single one of his own. He asked about her trip to Africa, then just listened - leaning in, nodding, letting her talk for twenty straight minutes.

The next day she wrote in the society column that he was, without question, the best conversationalist she'd ever met.

He never said a word about himself.

#kevintrudeau #communication #socialskills #successmindset #mindset #networking

A friend couldn't sell insurance to a man who'd already decided not to buy anything.

Kevin Trudeau tagged along to the meeting and noticed fishing photos on the man's mantle - trophy marlin, the real deal.

He never mentioned insurance. He asked about the fish. The man lit up and talked for ten straight minutes about the catch.

When the man finally asked to hear the pitch himself, he bought on the spot and became a repeat client.

People don't buy from the person who talks. They buy from the person who listens.

#kevintrudeau #salestips #businessmindset #successmindset #communication #wealthmindset
